Subject: Quarterly review prep — consolidated sales runway and per-account synopses

Team —

Quick kickoff for the upcoming quarterly review (Thursday, 20 Jan). I want a short, exportable packet we can hand to the execs: a consolidated forecast by close month + a one-paragraph (3 bullet max) synopsis per prioritized account for the QBR deck. Focus on: committed ARR, ask (PO/sig/POC), top risk, and required CS/SE action.

Please use the attached template (QBR_account_synopsis_template.xlsx) and drop a single updated row per account. Deadline: EOD Tue 12 Jan. I will do the mechanical consolidation on Wed and circulate the rollup for sign-off.

High-impact accounts to prioritize in your notes: Stratus Analytics, Meridian Health, (and any >$150k runway). If you have a negotiated PO or procurement constraint, flag it in the "risk" field.

Deliverables:
- Filled template per account
- One-slide bullet for any account with a new ask or change in close date

Thanks — short and practical here.

Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: QBR_account_synopsis_template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Subject: Re: Quarterly review prep — consolidated sales runway and per-account synopses

Mina —

Uploading Stratus notes (attached pdf) and pasting quick synopsis below. I also looped in Heidi to confirm procurement timing — we have a soft PO but procurement wants legal changes (SAML clause) before they can route.

Stratus Analytics — Current ask: finalize pilot + year-1 subscription (deal-DEAL-8921).
- Committed ARR: $245,000 (pilot -> expansion cadence)
- Close target: 2027-01-28 (moved from 2027-02-10)
- Top risk: Legal SAML clause & procurement scheduling (Procurement team requires 2-week turnaround)
- Required action: Legal to accept minimal SAML addendum; SE to prepare pilot acceptance test plan.

Attaching: 20270111-Stratus-account-note.pdf (meeting notes + mutual action plan stub).

—Marissa
